notes.title: V0.2.1 Patch 5, hello!
notes.notes:
Hope you're all still here
I apologize on my behalf for abandoning you all, but I was working on V0.2.2 and still am, but I decided to drop a patch for V0.2.1.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41896224/f943f0f34b0974f3babb29ce399f61a43d864e64.jpg
This update brings some quality of life changes, fixes exploits and glitches, and a little optimization update. Let's get on and check what is new, changed or removed!


Networking

+ Dedicated server support - you no longer have to worry about players closing their local servers


Workshop

+ Finally works - I don't know what I did, but the workshop broke so I had to fix it If you have made a map in the past, and notice issues with it (such as custom data like weaponry, health or others being the default) then you must update the map and put the values once again


Survival

+ Added the Winchester 1897, Keyboard and Frying Pan to the loot spawn as they were removed, now brought back
+ Attachments now useful - now you can put them on most guns
+ Tougher helicopter - it is not as sensitive, so now if you crash it won't explode most of the time unlike before
+ You can get out of moving cars - it will be harmful, but in V0.2.2, it will be more fun as you turn into an active ragdoll
- No more "odd" inventory spaces - you remember those weird 2 item slots you would get when picking up a T-Shirt? They're removed, because they were broken, and confusing
- "Survival Kit"s are no more - they are gone, as they provided unfair advantage and would confuse newbies
- Storage crates are gone - because of how V0.2.1 is coded, to have storage properly work it would be a waste of time, so for now you can still craft crates, but as decorative purposes


Glitches

+ Fixed Zombie Infection - now playable, zombies have hitboxes and winning is possible
+ Fixed notes, items, clothes and guns in survival - they had a weird hitbox with vehicles if you drove over them causing you to fling
+ Fixed an issue (probably) in survival where if you picked up items after a certain while, it would "corrupt" your inventory, meaning you couldn't die, leave or properly drop stuff
+ Fixed an issue with the Scar-L - equipping it would "corrupt" you
+ Fixed vehicles - the Military JEEP and other vehicles shouldn't flip easily, gears actually work, and the tires don't freakout anymore
+ Fixed damage in vehicles - now if you drive you shouldn't randomly get killed


Weapons

+ Brought back the RPG, Barrett M82 and the RPK - Don't expect them 100% in V0.2.2, this is just an experiment I'm trying out
+ Buffed out the Winchester 1897, little bit more damage and more muzzle velocity


Armour

- Removed the other exoskeletons, they were just unfair and not fun to play against with, there is only the 'Hand-Made Exoskeleton'
- Removed the really unbalanced helmets, there is only the 'Starter's Helmet' which has been fixed so now when it breaks, it actually does  instead of causing problems


Audio

+ Brought back some old footsteps - they sound better (you can decide which footsteps to use in the settings menu)
+ VOIP modifications - now it is a little higher quality, and a little louder so you can actually hear people


Peformance

+ The main menu and loadout should not lag anymore - prior to this patch, having many clothes would cause the main menu to stutter terribly


Other

+ New store page refresh, with new screenshots and trailer
+ Added crosshairs from the work in progress, V0.2.2
+ Chat is better - messages don't disappear and you can scroll through all the messages
+ Increased FOV slider - in older versions they were high, but a patch got them to be really low, so it has been "finally" reverted
+ The player (when shirtless) shouldn't look as weird anymore
+ The game's icon has been slightly upscaled - it was uploaded at a really small resolution, which has been corrected now
+ Experimental official Linux and MacOS Builds - if you own a steam deck, or use linux, now you can play voc without having to use proton. I'm still testing around, and I don't own any linux machines, so I would love for feedback on this (they both have their own dedicated servers)
- Unfortunately the German and Croatian language have been removed, they were badly translated or were messed up, if a patch 6 happens then they will be added alongside other languages


Known Issues:

[strike] Only current known issue is that dedicated servers always have 0 as the player count on the server list, this is an issue from the server's end and will soon be fixed
 Mistakenly did a "full release", VoC is no where out of early access and was done accidentally due to Steamwork's confusing releasing for dedicated servers, as we were trying to release that instead but released the whole game as a full release.[/strike]


New Trailer
[previewyoutube=gIuQGwhvwIM;full][/previewyoutube]

More information, thoughts and updates on everything regarding VoC:
There probably are some other small changes done, or bugs fixed that I forgot to mention

The update is 1GB because of how VoC is compressed (meaning every new version I do, the files get rebuilt even if there was no change), expect probably some other patches in the future regarding V0.2.1 if I find more problems that can be resolved without rewriting half of the game

If I haven't already uploaded the MacOS, Linux and windows dedicated servers it means they will come out soon, they are still being compiled 
as I'm writing and will take some time to be done, they will be released when ready

Performance should remain the same as before, because VoC was coded and made is really inefficient (purpose of V0.2.2 is to fix all of this), so I apologize for performance problems if you run into them (I recommend to restart your client if you experience this)

Yes V0.2.2 Is still in development, it's going well and I will probably launch a closed beta and invite few people into it to get more feedback, if you want to be updated more regarding V0.2.2 and about the probable closed beta, you can do so by joining The Discord Server


That is pretty much it, I'm hoping to see you the end of this year hopefully with the release of V0.2.2 if all things go well!

notes.title: V0.2.1 Patch 4
notes.notes:
The 4th patch finally, this update took a while but it brings a lot (not that much, but hella great stuff). Also like usual since its a patch the changes won't be categorized

- Some more brutal gore! If you damage an enemy in any way, blood will be shown on their clothing and skin depending on what you hit them, a gun will leave a bullet hole, a melee can leave just blood or a laceration. The only way to disable it is if you're running on vertex or have gore disabled
- The vehicles have been given some better controls, depending on the vehicle going uphill is possible or even easier, no more delays when accelerating or steering, and some other great stuff
- The "How to Play" page isn't stupid anymore; It's an actual tutorial! Currently I added tutorial for deathmatch where it will teach you the movement and knowledge on health, and also you can earn some special prizes if you complete it!
- The M1014 has been replaced by the Benelli M3! And fists have been reanimated
- Bridge has been given a graphical update, and zombie town is now normal sized
- Several sound updates, some sounds have been uncompressed, given higher quality or replaced
- Many textures have been updated or replaced with higher quality texture (expect more trough V0.2.2)
- Many bugfixes, one of many being that zombie infection is actually playable
- Danish Language has been removed
- Wolves have been given a new model (soon bears, because bears will be given a brutal update where they will eat their own victims)
- Grenades have their own sound upon impact with various surfaces, and the sound plays for everyone instead of being silent
- And other stuff!

There may be a 5th patch because V0.2.2 is going to be a big update, but I want to adjust the game before the great mighty update

notes.title: V0.2.0 release
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone, and happy (early or late) Easter! Currently I have holidays and I have been working for 3 months (including breaks) on 0.2.0! The most major and big content update as of now!
It contains a lot of features that can buff, nerf some gameplay and change how the game is played, let me know what you guys think!

Survival
+ VEHICLES HAVE BEEN FIXED! Third person view is much better, entering/exiting the vehicles don't instantly kill you, they don't cause lag anymore and also are easier to use
+ VEHICLES HOOD! You can open a vehicles hood and check their health from there and fill the gas if needed
+ CRAFTING! You can craft bases now (and optionally, you can create teams)
+ NEW PLACES! New houses, areas and territory!
+ Upon getting hit, your screen goes blurry on how high the damage is
+ Animals have their own cooldown upon barking and getting hit
+ More optimization to Survival, so hopefully more low end specs can run it
+ Remade how trees are cut; they will show their stump and also have new hitting sounds
+ Animals won't be able to detect you if hiding from them inside a building
+ Added some lore

Gameplay
+ WORKSHOP SYSTEM WITH A LEVEL EDITOR! You can finally make your own maps and let anyone play them! However its still very experimental and is going to be modified numerous times
+ ADDED DAILY AND WEEKLY CHALLENGES! This is very helpful to newcomers and to those that want a real challenge, rewards are based on difficulty
+ CHANGED GUN SYSTEM! Bullet spread will be accurate if standing and not spamming your gun, doing any of those will risk the accuracy
+ CHIAPPA TRIPLE TURNED INTO SAW OFF! Because I disliked the Chiappa Triple animations so I remade the gun into a saw off!
+ M16 TURNED INTO M4A1! However damage/recoil/speed is still the same, but RPM and other stats are different!
+ NEW CONSUMABLE SYSTEM! Consumables are actually worth the price as they boost you, more info below!
+ NEW ROUND OVER SCREEN! When a round is finished, you can vote for the next map!
+ NEW VOIP! FINALLY! The voice chat isn't bad anymore, it's the best now!
+ NEW MOVEMENT SOUNDS! New footsteps sounds and also landing on a surface has their own sound
+ Made automatic gunshots more accurate for clients (so if shooter shoots once, all clients receive that the shooter shot once instead of twice or none)
+ Switched AUG and FAL prices
- Temporarily removed bear trap consumable

General
+ REALISTIC FIRST PERSON ARMS! The cosmetics are modelled seperately for first person arms so they look very good!
+ New cosmetics; Pilot Helmet, Hockey Mask, Black Church Jacket and White Church Jacket
+ Characters are wider (so they look more human)
+ Made the female character thicker
+ Added more pain and death sounds to female
+ Added some more details to hands so they look better
+ Toned down achievement sound
+ Made male eyebrows thicker
+ Organized the Main Menu UI by making some elements smaller and just cleaning up how it looked
+ Languages have their own page so it doesn't take space on the menu
+ Ragdolls are better

Bugs
+ Fixed an animation issue where switching your gun when crouched would play the standing animation, which was not fair
+ Fixed (I think) an issue where if a player spawned you would see their outline for a frame
+ Fixed an issue where a player would scream tons of times without any reasons
+ Fixed the game sounds being so loud, causing your ears to explode
+ Fixed the black gloves being invisible
+ Fixed Zombie Infection

So about the consumables rework; they have been given a complete rework on how they work and also their animations too, if consuming an energy drink or pain killers it will give you a temporary boost which can allow you to; have a faster health regeration, sliding to be faster, use melees when running and also your whole movement to be faster
Currently the level editor is very experimental, it may contain some glitches but they will be fixed

Also I remade the trailer and added new screenshots, incase you wanted to know that.

Survival
+ You can cut trees with a Hatchet or with a Chainsaw
+ Added weather; Fog, Rain, Thunderstorm and Blizzard (which all of these give side effects when playing)
+ Added "Survival Kit"s when respawning you can spawn with a "Survival Kit" which gives you a character with some starter equipment to help out in the harsh freezing cold
+ Added vehicles; Military JEEP, Pick-up Truck, Van, Tractor and Police UAZ
+ Added interactable icons when looking at items or on vehicles

Gameplay

+ Added new map "Claustrophobia"; Play on a very small in doors map which can cause a lot of havoc
+ Added genders; You can either play as a male or as a female
+ Added two new guns; Mosin Nagant and Wesson Model 19 (in Survival as well)
+ Added proning (make good use of it!)

+ Nerfed all shotgun damages 
+ Pain and Death sounds change the fall off on how loud it is, EXAMPLE: If it is a painful scream more people will be able to hear it from far, but if it a weak scream not so much people will hear it

General

+ Added normal maps to shirts and pants so they look better

Bugs

+ Fixed an issue where gore wouldn't show to all clients
+ Fixed some cosmetics (that showed skin) having a weird shade
+ Fixed an issue where in Survival, when injecting drugs the breathing sound wouldn't go away

I might have forgot some because I have literally stayed up till 3 AM to work on the game only feeding on monsters and redbulls

notes.title: V0.1.8P3 RELEASE + HAPPY NEW YEARS!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, happy late Christmas and happy New Years! 2022 has been a blast; the game was released and had 3 updates (excluding the patch's).
Before the year starts here is V0.1.8P3 which will fix several issues and adds some new small features, also in 2023 I'll start working on V0.1.9

Survival
+ New Military base with a bunker that contains very high loot (wanna know a hint? it's in one of the corners, and is near the centre town)
+ Huge optimization: Buildings and objects disable from far and you can change the terrain's quality or the snow in the settings
+ Added new items: PKM Magazine | Soda Bottle | Energy Drink | Water Bottle | Apple Juice | Biscuits | Cereal | Noodles | Morphine
+ Added new guns: PKM | SVD
+ When you get damaged from Hypothermia/Hunger/Thirst a blue screen will flash rather than the red screen


Gameplay
+ Footsteps system modified: The falloff changes on how loud footstep is (EXAMPLE: If running; people can hear you from far | If crouching; people only hear you if they are half a meter way from you 
+ Reduced MP40 bullet spread so newbies don't cry
+ Grenade pulling/throwing can be heard only if close to the player throwing it
+ When falling off a slope, the fall speed gets higher
+ Now when aiming your mouse sensitivity is divided by 2


General
+ Energy Drink consumable is now a cranberry drink (for the holiday motive)
+ New Cosmetic Category: Beard
+ New Hair Cosmetics: Uncle Hair and Bald Hair
+ Translated the game into Russian; the shop however and some stuff in survival are still in english, we will be working this on V0.1.9


Bugs
+ Winchester Cocking sound shouldn't play from far anymore
+ Fixed an issue with the Energy Drink consumable where you could see an extra model when drinking it
+ Hopefully fixed an issue where clients would be disconnected when a round ended
+ Survival now shouldn't disconnect clients as often, so you can actually play it now
+ Fixed all explosions, they for some reason wouldn't register players

And as usual report any bugs or any errors you find, to the Discord Server (https://discord.gg/Avq4EWNsN9) or in the Steam Discussion (https://steamcommunity.com/app/1886120/discussions/0/5479214724390681592/)

notes.title: V0.1.8 release
notes.notes:
Happy Early Christmas everyone! As a surprise heres V0.1.8 (a major update) with tons of new features and quality life changes

Gameplay
! MAJOR !
  + NEW SURVIVAL GAME MODE! Survive in the frozen USSR Siberian steppes, team up with other survivors to make it through the wilderness and prevail against enemies.
  + HEADSHOTS HAVE CHANGED! Hitting the frontal lobe is still an instant kill, for the back and jaw they need 2-3 shots to kill an enemy
  + HITBOX NERF! Damage is less now, so you can survive more shots

+ M1 Garand and AUG have been nerfed; M1 Garand is slower and AUG is slower by 30% and ammo is now 40/120
+ Jump delay is reduced, so you can hold space without as much jump delay
+ Run strafing has been removed, you can't anymore go back or strafe at the same time as sprinting

General
+ Backpacks are added to presents and crates! Because I forgot to when I first released v0.1.6
+ Delays are now now reduced when an enemy is killed
+ Your playermodel should now save trough Steam Cloud, so when changing devices you should still have the same cosmetics equipped
+ Equipping gun has an animation on your view as well
+ Bat has got some few reworks; changed viewmodel position and added some more details to animations
· Changed "Lobby - Europe" to "Global Lobby" to avoid confusion

Maps
+ Since it's Christmas, most maps are snow or christmas themed

Bugs
+ Fixed "Normal Zombie" having some weird broken clothing (since it looked like it had white trail or white spaghetti)
+ Getting stuck or your movement disabled should be now fixed 

You may also expect some patches or updates that may change the new "Survival" game-mode; adding new locations and such

notes.title: Voice of Chernobyl Update
notes.notes:
The First "Steam" update, this is a big update so I may not list everything in the change-log as the changes are small to notice, or I want you guys to find out by your selves!
Sorry for the delay (9 months), As I wanted all of the new features in, and also to look good!

Networking
· No more dataloss, all your statistics is saved through Steam!
· Bandwidth usage is hopefully reduced

Gamemodes
+ Theres a new round over screen, showing the Top 3 players
· Zombie Infection and Melee Fight has been fixed

Gameplay
+ Character Customization is powered by Steam, you can now earn Cosmetics when you open crates or buying them (you can also sell the cosmetics and more!)
+ Cosmetics have more variety, they can have different colours or have unusual effects
+ The movement is physics based (expect more changes to it in the future)
+ Sliding has been added (just run and then crouch and you slide/glide)
+ Bleeding has been added (can be caused by sharp melee)
+ In the main menu you can see your Steam Friends on the right, you can invite them or message them
+ New death and pain sounds
+ Gore system is now more brutal: Headshots depend on where you shoot an enemy, shooting them in the jaw have their own gib, same with the frontal and occiptal lobe, and all of the gibs should sound/look good
+ Vehicles are now added for "Vehicle_Playground" [EXPERIMENTAL]
+ New footsteps that are better and that fit the game (when running they will be louder, have cloth/gear sounds and have more bass)
· Exo-Skeletons have been changed
· Audio Muffling (happens when a sound is far) is now enabled no matter what
- Removed "Carnival" from Zombie Infection, as people prefered "Zombie Town" more
- "Kicking" Movement has been removed (i was suppose to remove it back in test versions lol)

General
+ Brand new lighting that looks very good, is baked, and gives better peformance
+ New weapon bob (Its much smoother and looks x10 better than the old one)
+ Fists have their own animation when running
+ When starting the game a loading screen will show up
+ Main menu has a background ambience so it isn't empty anymore!
+ The higher the damage is, the more painful your screams will be
+ Settings include a new window named "Effect Settings" in which you can change: Color Grading | Ambient Occlusion | Motion Blur | Bloom
· Most cosmetics have been changed, they might have a different model or were replaced with a new cosmetic
· The loading screen has a transition, and will show the details of the room without a delay (if you have a poor connection it might delay)
· The game size is now less, and has been optimized so it should run on most computers/laptops
· The main menu is more UI friendly, it has transitions when going to different pages (next version will include camera transition)
· For taunts I may add in the future a "taunt" section in the shop, so I don't have to replace taunts
· Blood particle is better
· Most materials or props have their reflective intensity lower, so it doesn't look like it has been bleached a million times 
· Changed Fists sounds
- Removed the "Codes" and "Statistics" pages from the main menu, they may be re-added with new features or be replaced
- Removed the Charging sounds

Weapons
+ New SMG: P90
+ New Shotgun: Spas 12
+ New Pistol: Deaglenator
+ New Melee: Pan
+ New Melee: Buritto
· RPK and the VSS have high quality sounds
· M9 Bayonet and Shadow Knife both got animation reworks

Maps
+ Reactor (futuristic/sci-fi reactor, available for tdm and dm)
+ Abandoned Base (rainy base took by nature, available for melee fight)
+ Graveyard (a field containing tons of cemeterys and a church, available for melee fight)
· Modified Sniper Hideout and Bunker
- Removed the Christmas theme to most maps

Bugs
· Ladders finally work
· Fixed some weapon descriptions
· Fixed player names place incorrect when taunting
· Weapons don't become white when using Vertex rendering
· Fixed some other issues

Settings
+ New friendly UI
+ View Distance can be adjusted
+ Quality settings are easier to understand
+ New quality setting: Bean-PC (lowers down the game by a lot and force disables post processing)
· Better shaders has been turned into pipeline (contains 3 settings: deferred, forward, vertex)
· FOV can be changed now

And again, If I haven't listed everything is because they are too small notice, or I want you guys to find out by your selves!
If you do find any bugs please report them in the Steam Discussions or in the Discord Server!
